propositions: A deterministic clarity floor must detect only structurally incompatible plan states, not prose style preferences, and must be validated against closed tickets with signed plan-review and completion evidence to eliminate false positives.

Nonempty parsed acceptance-criteria checkbox items and narrowed unresolved-sentinel assignments in active execution sections are retained as hard-floor rules; exact-duplicate ACs, preferred section shape, and per-AC proof coverage are advisory only.

The rule for bare TBD/TODO/FIXME/??? sentinels must fire only when the sentinel occupies an unresolved value position (line start, after colon/equals/is/remains) and suppress same-line removal assertions; the earlier superseded-section exclusion is removed as undefined.
File-impact path/reason integrity and [rebar:id] direct-edge validation belong to write-schema and grounding-exception subsystems respectively, not to raw clarity scoring.

Historical searches found zero counterexamples to the narrowed sentinel rule and zero counterexamples to nonempty AC items, but counterexample 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88 (duplicate global make gate) and counterexample 6673-7636-a116-4f90 (transitive provenance citations) disprove naive duplicate-AC and naive direct-edge rules.

Negative control tests require c244-ba53-6280-4702 to pass the sentinel rule, 8d27 to not hard-fail for redundant global gates, 6673 and 94f9 to not fail for provenance/downstream citations, and empty/whitespace AC items to fail.
